name: Synthesis of [Co(ttpp)(py)2](OTf)
plain_text_description:
Purpose: Obtain Co(III) precursor free of PBA, because PBA may reduce Co(III) in basic conditions
Reference: AD-R11; py instead of pba
Analysis
1H NMR: [Co(ttpp)(py)₂]+, glue
ICP-OES: theoretical Cobalt content: 2.93%, experimental Cobalt content: 2.98%, Ag: 0.00213 eq.
SEM-EDX (AD-R016): No Cl, Ag
Product
Identity: [Co(ttpp)(py) 2](OTf)
Purity: Co and Ag not confirmed
Problems
None

Procedure
RT 22.6°C RH 32 %
Stock solution preparation
5 mL vial
Put into the glovebox (H₂O < 1 ppm)
Weigh in AgOTf → 14.52 mg
Take it out of the glovebox. 
Add toluene 550 µL → colorless solution

Reaction
10 mL flask
Add Co(ttpp)
Add pyridine
Add toluene 5 mL
Sonicate for 3 min → Dark green solution 
Cover with aluminum foil
Start stirring at 400 rpm
Add 500 µL of AgOTf/toluene dropwise with a mechanical pipette [syringe should be used]
Sonicate [unnecessary]
-> 50 μL + CDCl₃ (w/ Ag foil) 550 μL -> 1H NMR M1 [unnecessary]
Continue stirring for 1 h
-> 50 μL + CDCl₃ 550 μL -> ¹H NMR M2 (U1.834) [next time use pipette, SW 19, NS 16]
plain_text_observation:
Ag scavenging
Remove volatiles with rotovap (40 °C) → took 1.5 h
Dry under vacuum o/n
12.02.2026 RT 23 °C RH 34%
Add DCM 5 mL
Swirl and sonicate for 5 min → Dark green solution [5 min unnecessary]
Add ISOLUTE Si-Thiol
Stir at 500 rpm for 2 h
12 mL plastic syringe, cotton plug, syringe filter (⌀ 25 mm, 0.45 μm, PTFE), syringe filter (0.2 µm, ⌀ 15 mm, PET), 100 mL RBF [PTFE syringe filter next time should be used]
Filter the mixture → Dark green filtrate collected
Transfer and rinse with DCM 10 mL → Pale green filtrate in the end

Reprecipitation
Add n-hexane (60 mL).
Swirl and sonicate
Refrigerate at 4 °C for 3 h
Membrane filter (0.22 µm, hydrophobic, PVDF, tare with weighing bottle: 16.78675 g), membrane filter holder, 250 mL RBF
Filter the mixture → Dark orange filtrate
Transfer and rinse with 2 x (DCM 3 mL + n-hexane 20 mL)
Rinse w/ hexane 4 x 4 mL
Dry w/ suction for 5 min
Weighing bottle
→ Weigh → 88.7 mg; some of the residue stuck on the glass funnel and could not be collected) [unnecessary]
→ 1H NMR M3 (CDCl3) [unnecessary]
Dry under vacuum o/n

Analysis
13.02.2026 RT x °C RH y%
Vial (tare 8.04848 g)
Transfer from the membrane → residual solids on membrane → ¹H NMR membrane (CDCl₃) [unnecessary]
→ Weigh
→ 1H NMR P (CDCl₃; U1.834) [next time SW 19, NS 16. higher concentration]
→ ICP-OES (Co, Ag) → 17.5 mg 
For sample preparation, an accurately weighed amount of compound, 17.5 mg, was transferred into microwave digestion vials. A minimal volume of concentrated nitric acid (HNO₃) was added, followed by hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) to a total digestion volume of approximately 5 mL. The resulting mixtures were subjected to microwave-assisted digestion at 200 °C for 2 hours to ensure complete decomposition of the organic matrix.
After cooling to room temperature, the digestion mixture was transferred to a 10-mL volumetric flask and diluted to the mark with deionized water. The solution was kept overnight. The solution was transferred into the test tubes.
Initial ICP-OES measurements resulted in signals exceeding the calibration range for cobalt, indicating that the analyte concentration was too high. Therefore, an additional dilution step was performed by transferring 2 mL of solution into a new test tube and diluting to 10 mL with deionized water (dilution factor = 5). These diluted samples were subsequently remeasured.
